Embedded Software Engineer I 
 Mossville, IL  |  Onsite  |  Full-Time
 
  Diversified Services Network, Inc. (DSN) is seeking a full-time Embedded Software Engineer I to join our team in Mossville, IL. We offer full benefits, PTO, 401k, and more! If you're looking to grow your career within an extremely reputable, stable Fortune 100 company - let's talk!
 
 Position Overview 
 This entry-level role joins a Core Information Software development team, giving a new graduate the opportunity to apply classroom and lab experience to production embedded software for connected devices.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 •         Design, code, and test embedded software features for connected devices
 •         Integrate software components across the platform stack and validate network communication functionality
 •         Debug and troubleshoot software issues on target hardware
 •         Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and testing alongside senior engineers
 •         Document software designs and test results
 Requirements 
 •         Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering or Electrical Engineering from a U.S.-based institution, completed by December 2026
 •         Classwork and lab or project experience implementing software for embedded Linux
 •         Programming experience in C, C++, and/or Rust
 •         Exposure to Linux middleware and application development
 •         Working knowledge of Ethernet, TCP/IP, and Wi-Fi networking
 •         Availability to start in January 2027
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 •         Academic or personal project experience designing entertainment or connectivity-type embedded devices (e.g., infotainment, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/cellular communication software)
 Benefits 
 401(k)
 Dental insurance
 Vision Insurance
 Disability insurance
 Employee assistance program
 Health insurance
 Health savings account
 Life insurance
 Paid time off
 Paid Holidays
 Please follow the link to our website for a list of job openings in Engineering, IT, Project Management, and more! https://www.dsnworldwide.com 
 
 Salary expectations: 75,000-80,000 per annual
